gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-anek-gurmuk: Neuropolitical glows like neon tubing, its letters pulled slightly apart. Anek Gurmukhi carries paragraph after paragraph without strain, its big counters and generous curves keeping each line breathable.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-anek-kannad: Anek Kannada stands tall, with a squared-off, woodblock height to its lowercase. Neuropolitical bends its strokes like copper pipe, and that tubular glow against the sturdy text is what makes the pair stand out.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-anek-latin: Neon wire meets tall lowercase: every stroke here holds one thickness, like drawn cable. Neuropolitical grabs the eye while Anek Latin does the quiet work, its letters held open and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-anek-malaya: Anek Malayalam reads compactly, with lowercase close to cap height and curves whose tips never quite touch. Beside Neuropolitical, with its rod-stock strokes, it feels gentler and more open.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-anek-odia: Contemporary and clean, Anek Odia leaves its rounds open like unlatched hooks. After the glowing Neuropolitical heading, paragraphs in it run smoothly, capitals barely rising above the lowercase line.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads modern, its big round lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped curves giving each word a loose, open feel. Shrink Neuropolitical and its spaghetti-like strokes lose their glow.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads open and approachable, built on wide, tall bowls. Neuropolitical does the showy work with uniform neon-tube strokes, while Anek Telugu handles steady reading with its unlatched curves.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-anuphan: Neuropolitical glides under the eye like wire, its letters pulled apart one by one. Anuphan brings big round lowercase bowls to the text, and curves with clear gaps, clean and unfussy.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-arimo: Neuropolitical draws its neon-tube letters with no stroke shading at all, each one spaced apart. Arimo follows with a tall mean line and spacious curve gaps, so paragraphs stay comfortable to read.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-armata: Neuropolitical builds each glyph from a ribbon of constant width. Armata supplies spacious gaps between characters and lowercase bodies that fill most of the height, giving the glowing heading a sturdy partner.
